description: This file defines the EntityListCache class, which extends AbstractEntityConditionCache to provide caching for lists of GenericValue objects based on entity conditions and ordering. It includes methods for retrieving, inserting, and removing cached entity lists, with support for in-memory reordering if necessary.

classes.name: EntityListCache
classes.description: A cache for lists of entity values, keyed by entity name, condition, and ordering. Supports fetching, inserting, and removing cached data with in-memory ordering when needed.

methods.name: EntityListCache
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the cache with a delegator name.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a list of GenericValue objects for a given entity and condition.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a list with specified ordering; reorders in memory if necessary.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Inserts a list of entities into the cache for a given entity and condition.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Inserts a list of entities into the cache with specified ordering.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a cached list for a given entity, condition, and order.

methods.name: getOrderByKey
methods.description: Returns a cache key object for a list of order by fields, or '{null}' if none.

search-terms: put(String entityName, EntityCondition condition, List<GenericValue> entities)
